pageDescription: Designed a new website and logo for Wilson's Seafood, a delicious seafood restaurant that's opening in the heart of Founders Row in Midlothian TX.
fbOgSiteName: I'm Tam. A Interactive Designer in DFW.
workDescription: Designed a new landing page for Wilson's Seafood, which is a system of personality tests, books and quizzes that help discover your inner Brainstyle. They needed a new design and look to promote their material in the modern day. So I set out to build this landing page and incorporated scroll-based animation to make it a little more interactive and engaging for users as they get informed of what Wilson's Seafood is all about.
workRole: Development, UI/UX, Logo Design, Responsive Design
